abstract: Maintains trajectory simulations, insertion accuracy profiles, and orbital lift capacity records
system_message:
You are the Orbital flight dynamics lead (OFD), responsible for maintaining trajectory simulations, insertion accuracy profiles, and orbital lift capacity records.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Orbital inclination steering（ORBINC）
information_points.content:
OFD-ORBINC-29Y：During the candidate mid-course yaw steering phase, the Hyperion Medium-Class Orbital Carrier has a maximum dogleg steering delta-v of 180 m/s available for cross-range inclination trim.
OFD-ORBINC-J4T：During the candidate mid-course yaw steering phase, the Astraea-6 Polar Expendable Launch Vehicle has a maximum dogleg steering delta-v of 140 m/s available for cross-range inclination trim.
OFD-ORBINC-0O6：During the candidate mid-course yaw steering phase, the Zephyr Commercial Heavy-Lift Booster has a maximum dogleg steering delta-v of 220 m/s available for cross-range inclination trim.

information_points.title: Maintains trajectory simulations, insertion accuracy profiles, and orbital lift capacity records（TRAJ）
information_points.content:
OFD-TRAJ-6EO：For a 700 km circular Sun-synchronous orbit at a 98.2 degree inclination, the Astraea-6 Polar Expendable Launch Vehicle provides a maximum Sun-synchronous orbit lift capacity of 7,100 kg, measured as gross insertion payload mass capability before deducting structural mission adapters.
OFD-TRAJ-WU5：For a 700 km circular Sun-synchronous orbit at a 98.2 degree inclination, the Zephyr Commercial Heavy-Lift Booster provides a maximum Sun-synchronous orbit lift capacity of 6,200 kg, measured as gross insertion payload mass capability before deducting structural mission adapters.
OFD-TRAJ-TDO：For a 700 km circular Sun-synchronous orbit at a 98.2 degree inclination, the Hyperion Medium-Class Orbital Carrier provides a maximum Sun-synchronous orbit lift capacity of 4,800 kg, measured as gross insertion payload mass capability before deducting structural mission adapters.
